requirements.quote: The Stage B runbook lists the triggers (p95 above 400 ms, DB CPU above 60%, more than 1,000 seats), pre-checks, a cutover timeline that avoids the 18:00 to 23:00 and 07:00 to 10:30 IST freeze windows, rollback at every step, and communication templates [type:manual]

Terraform modules for RDS, S3, ALB, and optional Cloudflare LB validate and plan in CI with dummy credentials; region variables are validated to India regions only (`ap-south-1`, `ap-south-2`) [type:unit]

The RDS module enables encryption with a customer-managed KMS key, automated backups with PITR, a read replica in Hyderabad (`ap-south-2`), pgvector parameter group and private networking only (no public endpoint, policy test) [type:unit]
The S3 module blocks public access, enables versioning and SSE-KMS, applies per-workspace prefix IAM conditions, and replicates to a second India region; a policy test asserts all four [type:unit]
The ALB is the default multi-node entry; the Cloudflare LB module cannot be enabled without `residency_decision_ref` and a documented approval, matching the DNS-only app rule [type:unit]

`scale-readiness-check.ts` verifies the day-one rules (stateless containers, state only in Postgres and S3, env-only config, health and readiness endpoints, idempotent jobs, backward-compatible migrations) and fails CI if a rule regresses [type:unit]
`packages/storage` passes the same conformance suite against MinIO and an S3-compatible target, proving the provider swap needs only env changes [type:api]

A Postgres migration rehearsal on staging data (logical replication from the compose Postgres to a scratch Postgres) completes with row-count and RLS verification and measures cutover downtime, recorded in the runbook [type:manual]
requirements.why: Needs staging data and a scratch Postgres; cannot run on the shared host or in the lane. The lane delivers migrate-postgres-to-rds.sh (with row-count and RLS verification) and a rehearsal-results section in the runbook; the run is recorded after deploy.

requirements.quote: A MinIO to S3 sync rehearsal with checksum verification passes on seeded documents [type:manual]
requirements.why: Needs seeded documents on staging MinIO and a scratch S3 target; the lane delivers migrate-minio-to-s3.sh with a checksum-verify mode and a guarded shell test using stubs, the real rehearsal is recorded after deploy.

requirements.quote: Envelope encryption path is documented for the KMS move: KEK moves from env and secret manager to KMS with DEK re-wrap, referencing the key rotation runbook [type:manual]
Stage C document states the decision criteria for ECS Fargate vs k3s, Redis, OpenSearch and PowerSync, each with measurable triggers, and is reviewed in an ADR [type:manual]
A cost model compares Stage A, B and C per 1,000 seats in INR and checks the variable cost target per seat (PRD §8) [type:manual]
Nothing in this issue is applied automatically: apply requires the manual gated workflow from #99 [type:manual]
`.github/workflows/terraform.yml` (extend to plan Stage B modules with dummy vars)
This issue produces the runbook, Terraform modules (plan-able, not applied), and a migration rehearsal checklist. It does not perform the migration.

ECS Fargate vs k3s decision record, per-queue worker autoscaling, Redis, OpenSearch and PowerSync criteria each with measurable triggers; cost model Stage A/B/C per 1,000 seats in INR checked against the PRD §8 variable-cost target (docs/product/03-prd.md:335).
